description: Ministry of Higher Education, Technology and Innovations - Degree Awarding Institute Order - Institute of Chemistry, Ceylon
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the recognition of the Institute of Chemistry, Ceylon as a Degree Awarding Institute under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It is a legal order issued by the Minister, specifying conditions and degrees. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (new regulations, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements for an educational institute), not under government personnel/structure changes (Types 1-3) or other specialized categories.
